notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR7: an unterminated portion's disposition is undefined, but the "message does not logically exist for the MCS and hence cannot be sent to a destination". The portion lives only in the run unit's MessageControlSession dialogue (RunUnit.MessageControl), never in MessageStore; PURGE removes it and the end of the run unit drops it. Probed: run unit A sent a portion and an ESI segment to a queue destination, a device and an I-O terminal and stopped; run unit B saw queue count 0, its EMI-only SEND delivered an empty message (none of A's text), and neither device file got A's text. The witness only sends a portion and runs to completion.

next.reason: 1985: "the disposition of a portion of a message which is not terminated by an EMI or EGI or which has not been eliminated by the execution of a PURGE"; 2023: "SEND is now a message-server statement: "A message is sent to the run unit identified by the content of literal-1 or message-server-name-1"". 2023 SEND sends whole messages to a server run unit. It has no EMI/EGI partial messages and no PURGE, so the rule on unterminated message portions has no counterpart.
